policy.re_execution: FORBIDDEN - this pack is publication/communication over accepted evidence only; no retrain, retune, reacquire, rerun, or artifact rewrite
policy.numbers_source: accepted artifacts in results/historical_oos/ only; no number in this pack may originate outside them

accepted_evidence.accepted_head_subject: D9-B: FINAL 2025 WALK-FORWARD EVALUATION -- executed once, credible null
accepted_evidence.freeze_marker: FINAL CONFIGURATION FROZEN BEFORE HOLDOUT EVALUATION

experiment.config_diff_scope: status field + freeze_record block only; no numerical parameter changed

superseded_predecessors.statarb_hist_etf_wf_v3: invalidated-before-holdout (execution-timing + tie-break defects); never evaluated against 2025
superseded_predecessors.statarb_hist_oos_v1: SUPERSEDED / EXPLORATORY - wrong universe (PairFinder.SECTOR_PAIRS equities); its own 2025 run executed with 0 pairs selected; non-overlapping universe (its own 56-symbol equity-pair dataset; v1 records no symbol list, so non-overlap is asserted from the differing dataset/universe record, not an enumerated symbol comparison)

dataset.raw_data_note: Raw per-symbol CSVs are NOT committed to this repository (data/ contains manifests only). The dataset canonical hash is a manifest-declared value that agrees with the freeze_record; it cannot be re-derived from repository bytes and is treated as an accepted, disclosure-limited input.

generated.tables/window-level.csv: one row per walk-forward window across all four v4 buckets, straight from artifact fields
